Review_Text: i visited this tempat with my wife on 16 march,2019. its located in sln terminus. we were looking for a tempat to dine after our movie at platinum, and we decided to give this tempat a try. was it sepadan it, lets find out. ambiance ============ we entered this tempat around 10 pm on a saturday night and this tempat was literally bustling with crowd. they have several television screens set up at various nook and corners of the lounge, and all of them played sports channel, ranging from cricket to premier league football. we were promptly seated at the verandah. the view from there is quite something. we got seated in a semi lit corner. the tempat has a cozy feeling and good vibes. liked it. ratings - 4/5. pelayanan ============ pathetic. needs a lot of improvement. they took some time to produce the menu, and then the pelayan just didn't show up for the order, for next 15 minutes at-least. we ordered food and drinks. the food was delayed and drinks just did't come. we had to repeatedly ask the pelayan to serve the drinks at-least, so that we can end our boredom. luckily the food came soon after the drinks were served. when asked for the bill, they showed a mobile shot of the bill amount taken by the kasir, saying printer was faulty. phew! ratings - 1/5. food ============ did food proved to be the savior for the night? Dan yang di pasar minggu ini emang tempatnya lumayan luas dari pada cabang-cabang yang lainnya. Dan suasananya tuh kaya summer vibes gitu.Cheese Cake Cadbury, cake yang satu ini bagian cheese cakenya tebel banget, padat dan ga bikin eneg. Udah gitu ditambah lapisan cokelat diatasnya yang manis-manis lembut. Ehh masih ditambah sama potongan cokelat cadburry yang udah pada tau gimana rasanya ini cokelat.Istanbul Choco Cheese, cake yang satu ini ada beberapa lapisan, dan lebih dominan ke rasa cokelat. Untuk teksturnya, ada yang lembut, dan ada juga yang padat dan agak-agak sedikit kenyal. Yaa mungkin ini teksturnya seperti es krim nya yang terkenal dari istanbul sana. Tapi yang jelas, ini sama-sama lembut yang nikmat.Selain dessert yang jadi jagoannya Bittersweet, gue juga mesen maincourse, diantaranya Carbonara Beef Bacon. Spaghetti yang full sama keju dan susu ini emang creamy banget. uda gitu isiannya, si beef bacon ini juga banyak, Spaghetti nya juga lembut.Gue juga mesen Chicken Krispy, beberapa potong daging ayam fillet yang digoreng dengan tepung yang krispi, disajikan di mangkok tanpa nasi. Kalo yang ini cocok banget buat cemil-cemil ganteng nih. dan makannya pake saus biar lebih seru.Mango Spring Glass, minuman yang seger yang satu ini banyak potongan buah mangga yang manis dan lembut. Dan dengan tambahan susu, rasa minuman mangga ini jadi makin seger dan enak.Cappuccino, espresso dengan steamed milk ini, rasanya oke juga. Ga kalah sedapnya sama cappuccino- cappuccino yang ada di coffeeshop besar. Karena disini espressonya juga cukup terasa, dan cenderung ke bitter. Yaa namanya juga Bittersweet.©prido

Review_Text: this is located prominently along the main road and is a part of the same group which has the moti mahal chain of restaurants. hopped in for makan siang on a weekday after a movie at the nearby mall and it was a pengalaman baik to put it across in a lucid manner. the starters have mostly the usual fare you'd see in a typical barbeque restoran. there was chicken, fish, prawn, mutton seekh kebab, chicken tangdi, chicken meat balls etc. in the non veg fare. the veg had the typical paneer, pineapple, corn on the cob, crispy potatoes in sauce which i would say were delectable along with the crispy corns. there is a complimentary mocktail which was decent but the masala coke i ordered later had too much masala and too little fizz for my liking. the chats were toothsome and lip smackingly enak. i also liked the kulchhas and parathas in the main course. they were soft and had the right texture and rasa. just the way they should be. special mention of the veg and non veg manchow soup which was appetizing. my wife had multiple rounds of the same. the chicken, fish and mutton curries were good but i liked the dal makhni and matar methi malai among the lot. the gulab jamun and halwa along with the jalebi and rabdi were supremely enak in the desserts section. the pelayanan was quick and cepat. special mention of raghuveer singh who took care of our requirements and was always available when required. this is not a big tempat hence the ambiance is not much to talk about. they have seating on the first floor too which is an added bonus. all in all, this is definitely a tempat sepadan trying!

Review_Text: #delayedpost (date of visit jan 10) #foodshaukeen #chinesepavilion chinese pavilion was one tempat which was hiding in my wishlist for very long in chinese category and this wish was fulfilled when a friend wanted to throw a party in a chinese restoran, and i wasted no time in suggesting this 😉. visited gachibowli branch which is above ccd and is in the same building of up the bistro. their suasana does comply with their cuisine to most and their seating is quite comfortable and can seat up to 40 pax comfortably. pricing is a bit on higher end with most of the dishes are priced above 350 and very few are between 250 - 350 . a tummyful meal could go up to 1400 for 2 ai. have ordered manchow soup to start our meal which satisfied our rasa buds. red chilli prawns (dry), bbq chicken, three treasure veggies and honey glazed potato balls were part of appetizers. prawns teppan yaki, pan fried and tossed along with chilli garlic and butter tasted real good. bbq chicken was a decent attempt and could have been more better. show stealer among appetizers was definitely honey glazed potato balls which were enak with a punch of sweet and a little pepperish, a wonderful combo to your rasa buds. three treasure veggies had broccoli, baby corn and mushrooms and felt more like a salad for me. had it been a little more pan fried with its sauces, could have done wonders. among main course was schezwan fried rice and cp special noodles which is made of pan fried noodles and oyster sauce, tasted okish as sauce did not impress me as much as i expected. schezwan rice was enak though, right to the spices. requested for desserts and they dint have anything from their menu except honey noodles 😕. pelayanan : though their pelayanan is quick, staf is not so attentive to the customer for the ad hoc requests and also to take order. something that is important from customer point of view. bottomline : there were few misses and few hits. however, most of the dishes were towards sweeter side. i wouldnt mind another try here and see if my first visit is just an exception.

Review_Text: fisherman's wharf used to be our fav joint when we lived in goa. makanan sangat enak and bevs. then we moved to hyderabad, fmw followed. we were so happy, to have a goan restoran just 5 min drive from home. in the beginning it was great tempat to dine. then it started getting local. fishes started getting stale, fewer varieties ..not so great. now , after about 3 years, it's more a typical curry point. we ordered mutton xacuti and kingfish richado. fish was so firm and overcooked, richado overloaded with sweetness. mutton was out of the world, with heaps of curry leaves(kadi patta/karia paku) , super high on heat....reminded me of a rayala curry in dindi (godavari distt ). meat was cooked with extra affection that it took me 5 min to chew it like a bubblegum. i really thank myself for not ordering more. fisherman's wharf- such a disappointment.

Review_Text: komatose on a sunday night is the perfect tempat to be, happened to be drizzling, which made for the perfect atmosphere to chill outside in the cabanas. inside was a pretty small area for a bar, but had loads of seating space which extended out to a floor above, overlooking the area below. lighting was funky and great, the vibrant colors adding to the vibe. 💓 being a big bunch, we ordered different drinks and luckily i got to rasa all. the most special of these were from 'the 7 deadly sins of koma' menu. the rasa was as described on the menu. lust in particular was something different i'd never tasted before, a chilli-spiced vodka, strawberry infusion🌶️🍸. the appetizers we had we're really good, something i enjoyed more than the alcohol. dragon prawns🍤, grilled pomfret🐟, peshawar chapali kebabs are some of the must orders! didn't quite like the nawabi shikhampuri. while all the items tasted great, i felt the porsi sizes to be rather small for the harga. best for the last, not being a kid here, but the mocktails were just mind-blowing. had a few different fruit flavors, peach, mango, green apple, lime, out of which the peach was the best. multiple rounds of that gave me the sugar rush 🍹. the pelayanan was professional and quick. would've wished for better music, and there was no dj at the music station. however we had the freedom to play our own songs which was great! it's a perfect tempat to watch a match screening, have a party, or if you're in the mood for it, go into 'comatose' 😉. here's my overall score: food - 3.5/5 suasana - 3.5/5 vfm - 3.5/5 pelayanan - 3.5/5

Review_Text: this has been on my list for a while now, but for some reason, hadn't been able to make it there until recently. went in for makan siang with my colleagues. was impressed by the level of activity at this tempat, serving huge nos of online orders from a rather small kitchen (housed in a food court). we ordered mutton galouti kebab, veg seekh kebab, paneer kadhai, butter chicken, dal tadka, tandoori rotis and jeera rice. the mutton kebab was enak - the 'melt in the mouth and leave you wondering' kind - only possible improvement was that they could have made it a bit less salty - strictly nitpicking. the veg seekh kebab arrived slightly late and was not as good as the mutton, but still held a good rasa. the star for us was the butter chicken. slightly tangy, moderately spicy, slightly sweet, incredibly smooth and buttery, with huge pieces of chicken. i was bowled over..! so impressed was i, that the paneer kadhai, which was actually more than decent and very enak, failed to capture my attention..! the dal and the rotis were good, but paled in comparison with the magic of that butter chicken. the only less impressive dish among the lot was the jeera rice, which was almost devoid of all flavours except salt - could have been better. in all, a very pengalaman baik. i cant say value for money, but the food was impressive in general. sepadan more visits, any day..! thanks. food: 4.5/5 suasana: 4/5 (food court setup) pelayanan: 3.5/5 vfm: 3.5/5 (a tad mahal, but probably justified by the kualitas and rasa of the food)
